gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-stack-sans-notch: Classic and cultural in spirit, Edo SZ draws its lowercase with the weight of capitals, every stroke one constant width. Stack Sans Notch is plain sans built like rod stock, with open curves you can look straight into.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-stack-sans-text: Classic presence, one constant stroke: that is Edo SZ at its best. And Stack Sans Text, a modern sans with marker-like lines and big-bodied letters, is best at carrying the words.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-tiktok-sans: TikTok Sans is a modern sans with lowercase rising close to cap height. TikTok Sans leaves a spacious c, a loose counterpoint that lets Edo SZ's constant pen width stand out above it.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-ubuntu-sans: Ubuntu Sans is plain sans with strokes like bent copper pipe. Ubuntu Sans leaves its curves unfinished, the quality that stands out most beside Edo SZ's single constant stroke.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-alexandri: Alexandria is a sans-serif with wide c terminals and short stems above and below. Alexandria lets text roll along easily, a quiet follow-up to Eight Bit Dragon's relaxed, widely spaced stride.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-anek-deva: Towering, loose-limbed lowercase with moderate stroke contrast: that is Eight Bit Dragon. And Anek Devanagari, in plain sans form with distinctly open letter mouths, gives it somewhere steady to rest.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-anek-kann: Adventurous in stride, Eight Bit Dragon shifts weight only slightly, like stretched rubber cord. Anek Kannada, a sans-serif with high-reaching lowercase and terminals stopping far from the stem, does the steadier work of carrying text.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-anek-lati: Eight Bit Dragon strides across the line with widely separated letters and soft shifts in thickness. And Anek Latin, plain sans with lowercase nearly reaching the capitals, holds its letters open beneath that heading.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-anek-mala: Anek Malayalam is a clean sans-serif whose lowercase nearly meets the capitals. Beside Eight Bit Dragon's widely separated letters and gently thinning strokes, its curves stop short of touching, which gives the heading room to stride.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-anek-odia: Adventurous in its spacing, Eight Bit Dragon keeps a quiet stroke modulation under its towering lowercase. And Anek Odia, plain sans with unsealed rounds, reads smoothly across long lines of text.
